description: VidTools is a free, browser-based toolkit with fast media tools for downloading, converting, compressing, transcribing, and cleaning up video and audio so all in one place without annoying ads. There are no accounts, no sign-ups, and no watermarks, and the conversion, compression, and editing tools run locally in your browser, so your files never leave your device. It's built for creators, students, teams, and marketers who want to skip the extra app, download, or subscription.
